blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/elmhurst/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/elmhurst/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/elmhurst/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/elmhurst/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/elmhurst/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: Is yearly sewer cleaning normal in Elmhurst?
items.preview: For clay lines with roots, yes.
items.answer: For clay lines with known roots, yes. It's far cheaper than a backup.

items.q: Should I keep maintaining or just replace the line?
items.answer: If the pipe is sound apart from roots, maintenance is fine. If it's cracked or sagging, a liner or repair can end the yearly visits.

items.preview: It helps your line, but not an overloaded sewer.
items.answer: A clean line drains better. For storm backups, you need a backflow valve or [overhead sewer](/elmhurst/overhead-sewer-systems).

items.q: Is sewer maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits. Ask how it applies to your sewer.

items.q: Can I do maintenance myself with root killer?
items.preview: It helps slow regrowth, not clear clogs.
items.answer: Root treatments can slow regrowth after a cleaning, but they don't replace it.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether your line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
